title: Microsoft killed FoxPro in 2007. Anyway, here's FoxPro revived
summary: A developer revived Visual FoxPro, discontinued in 2007, by reimplementing its language on a new Rust-to-WASM runtime validated against the real vfp9.exe. The project removes the 2 GB table limit, keeps legacy 32-bit .fll add-ins working, and adds lambdas, JSON, and an HTTP server. Reports and signed builds remain unfinished. It targets businesses still running aging FoxPro apps they cannot afford to rewrite.
